title: Ministries — Baker Road Baptist Church
metaDescription: Student ministry, children's ministry, Crosswalk for men, women's ministry, adult Bible study, and the Care Team at Baker Road Baptist Church in Baytown.
headline: Places to belong.
intro: Every member is a minister here. Some of these meet weekly, some monthly, and all of them will make room for one more.

items.title: ONE Student Ministry
items.body: Grades 6 through 12. Our students meet Wednesday nights after dinner, and have their own Sunday School class at 9:00. Teaching, games, and adults who actually know their names.

items.title: Children's Ministry
items.body: Birth through 5th grade. We work hard to give kids a safe place to learn how much God loves them, and to give parents real confidence about who is watching their children.

items.title: Crosswalk
items.meta: Contact the office for the next gathering
items.body: The men of Baker Road, gathering for breakfast, service projects, and the plain work of sharpening one another. “Iron sharpens iron, and one person sharpens another.” Proverbs 27:17

items.title: Women's Ministry
items.body: The Ladies Bible Fellowship class meets Sunday mornings at 9:00 and is open to women of every age and stage. Fellowship and service events run through the year.

items.title: Bible Study
items.body: Adult Bible study sits at the heart of this church. Sunday mornings the Rooted and Grounded class digs into Scripture together, and Wednesday nights go deeper still.

items.title: Care Team
items.meta: Need care, or want to help? Call the office
items.body: When someone in this church is in the hospital, grieving, or just quietly struggling, the Care Team is who shows up. Meals, visits, rides, and prayer.

items.title: Find your place
items.meta: Tell us what you are good at
items.body: Worship team, media and sound, transportation, hospitality, childcare, Sunday School teaching. If you can do it, we can use it.
